title: hix.projection/v1
description: Manifest written as hix-projection.json at the root of a materialization output. One schema covers both materialization targets; target-specific fields are documented per property. The manifest is also read back as composition evidence, so it is a stable wire format rather than a report.

source.description: Portable identity of the observed source composition. Contains no absolute or machine-specific paths.

capability.description: Emitted only by the Codex-target materializer, where it duplicates `skill`. The Claude-target materializer omits it.

choices.description: Operator choices that were required to resolve the materialization. Keys are target-namespaced: a Codex-target manifest carries only codex* keys, a Claude-target manifest only claude* keys. Every key is absent when the operator made no such choice, so an unresolved-free portable materialization serializes this as an empty object.

resolutions.description: One entry per source behavior dimension that was given an explicit target realization.

runtimeRequirements.description: Constraints the target runtime must satisfy for the materialized capability to keep its source authority envelope. Empty when the composition carried none.

configuration.description: Runtime-specific configuration blob. Deliberately open: its keys name settings of the target harness, not of hix.

launch.description: Concrete launch invocation that satisfies the requirement, when one can be expressed as a command.

evidence.description: Deliberately open. The only guaranteed key is `kind`; the remaining keys vary with the kind of evidence backing the requirement.

files.description: Every file the materialization wrote, as slash-separated paths relative to the output root.

claims.description: Explicit negative claims. hix never asserts cross-harness equivalence from a materialization.
